precedence: CRITICAL_CHANGE > NETWORK_CHANGE > BOUNDED_CHANGE; DELETE fallback is NETWORK_CHANGE unless a higher rule matches.
safety: Risk classification is deterministic and cannot downgrade a critical path because another lower-risk token is also present.
Unknown CREATE/UPDATE is never READ_ONLY/PLAN_ONLY; it defaults to BOUNDED_CHANGE.
Unknown DELETE is at least NETWORK_CHANGE.
